## 📌 Overview

This project is a **marketing agency landing page** designed to demonstrate modern front-end practices using **Jekyll**.

It focuses on:

* Clean UI design
* Modular architecture using includes
* Scalable SCSS structure
* Mobile-first responsive layout

---

## 🛠️ Tech Stack

* **Jekyll** – Static site generator
* **Liquid** – Templating engine
* **SCSS (Sass)** – Modular styling
* **HTML5 & CSS3** – Semantic and responsive layout
* **Vercel / GitHub Pages** – Deployment

---

## 📂 Project Structure

```
.
├── _layouts        # Layout templates
├── _includes       # Reusable components (header, hero, etc.)
├── _sass           # SCSS partials
├── assets
│   ├── css         # Main stylesheet
│   └── images      # Image assets
├── index.html      # Entry point
├── _config.yml     # Jekyll configuration
```

---

## ✨ Features

* ✅ Responsive hero section
* ✅ Reusable components (header, features, services)
* ✅ Clean and modern UI
* ✅ Mobile-first design approach
* ✅ Easy to extend and maintain

---

## 🚀 Getting Started

### 1. Install dependencies

```bash
bundle install
```

### 2. Run locally

```bash
bundle exec jekyll serve
```

### 3. Open in browser

```
http://127.0.0.1:4000/
```

---

## 📦 Deployment

This project can be deployed using:

* **Vercel** (custom Jekyll build configuration)
* **GitHub Pages** (native Jekyll support)

---

## 🧠 What I Learned

* Structuring scalable layouts with Jekyll
* Creating reusable components with Liquid includes
* Organizing SCSS using partials
* Building responsive, mobile-first UI
* Deploying static sites using modern platforms
